claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch at 6:24 p.m. EDT (22:24 UTC).
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch from Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II has a two-hour launch window.
Backup date for the Artemis II launch is April 2, 2026.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on NASA YouTube and NASA+ starting earlier in the day.
Full coverage of the Artemis II launch is at 12:50 p.m. ET.
The weather is currently 80% favorable for the Artemis II launch.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission will carry four astronauts around the Moon
